The AI Boom Rolls On: AI Partnerships Pay Off as Stocks Soar & Meta, Google & Microsoft Go All-In

The October 31 wrap reviews hyperscaler results and compares their ability to finance AI investment. Eisman also separates resilient card-network spending from Fiserv weakness, persistent housing problems and managed-care strain.

The near-term Nvidia earnings expectation was supported by the following report. The more ambitious Meta-versus-cloud-provider return comparison is not established by market capitalization or cash-balance changes alone. His company differentiation is stronger than blanket claims that rate cuts or AI announcements always help stocks.

How he reasons here

  • Distinguish current cloud revenue from uncertain future monetization.
  • Check funding capacity as capex rises.
  • Differentiate a strong sector from a weak business model within it.
  • Separate guidance, earnings quality and price reaction.
